description:
Arc 43 A22 self-application produced FAIL 144→56 + STRANGE 36→12, a 61%/67% reduction. The remaining 56 + 12 are enumerated in 10 residue categories at agents/observation/spec-validation/mechanical-check-results.md (Arc 43 self-application section). Each category is a known parser limitation with a known fix-shape; closing them is future-arc scope.

## Residue categories (per mech-check-results.md Arc 43 self-application)

**check-1 (7 categories ~52 FAILs):**
1. Form (a) over-capture of literal §N placeholder in spec line 7 'Reading note'
2. Form (b) §13.x anchor over-capture (placeholder/glob in prose)
3. Form (b) range-syntax over-capture (§N-§M / §13.5-§13.10)
4. Form (b) trailing-dot anchor greedy capture (§5.10. / §7.1. etc.)
5. Form (b) hyphenated prose token over-capture (§12-internal-staleness)
6. Form (c) **PLINY** / **POLYBIUS** shorthand inference gap (Form (c) requires literal CAPTAIN_*/MAJOR_* prefix; bold-shorthand doesn't match)
7. Misc legitimate cross-refs not resolving via current heuristics

**check-2 (3 categories ~13 STRANGE):**
8. Line-level vs ticket-level classification ambiguity (multiple tickets per line)
9. \bdeferred\b over-match against 'Deferred-with-gating' compound
10. Genuinely-ambiguous lines with no structured-claim shape

## Empirical anchor

Arc 43 ship (cd9b11a, 2026-05-19); ARGUS rev1 pass-1 simulation surfaced; DAEDALUS rev1 enumerated; CATO + VERA + ZENO Phase 3 all ratified as honest residue per stoa--bbi refined-principle thesis (residue IS data; structural fix narrows drift surface but doesn't eliminate).

## Out of scope here

- Closing ALL 10 categories in one ticket — split into smaller scopes per future-arc cohesion
- Wholesale parser rewrite — these are incremental refinements over the Arc 43 base
- SPECIFICATION.md structural changes (e.g., escape the §N placeholders) — that's spec-edit scope, not parser-refinement scope

## Sequencing

P3. Not blocking. After PRINCIPAL transitions to product-mode-ready (post-Arc-43 substrate-team posture); pick up if/when validate-spec residue becomes operationally noisy in future arcs OR if a future substrate-team arc has scope-cohesion with parser refinement.

## Cross-refs

- Companion: stoa--bbi (refined-principle thesis evidence accretion)
- Artifact: agents/observation/spec-validation/mechanical-check-results.md (Arc 43 self-application section)
- Arc 43 ship: cd9b11a (PR #23)
